subject: recordTable: Generate a species record table from camera trap images

messages.author: 7544ac5103fe3a16
messages.subject: recordTable: Generate a species record table from camera trap images
parts:
Dear Jurgen,

I am trying to create a record table with the recordTable function.

But I get an error message, which I cannot seem to be ablt to resolve:

> record_table <- recordTable(inDir = "images_renamed",
+ IDfrom = "directory",
+ cameraID = "filename",
+ camerasIndependent = TRUE,
+ minDeltaTime = 60,
+ deltaTimeComparedTo = "lastRecord",
+ outDir = "images_renamed",
+ writecsv = TRUE,
+ timeZone = "Asia/Vientiane"
+ #additionalMetadataTags = c("Model", "Make"),
+ )
Error in matrix(unlist(lapply(tmp1, FUN = function(X) { :
  'data' must be of a vector type, was 'NULL'
> record_table
Error: object 'record_table' not found

Any idea what the problem could be?

Thank you very much,
Camille.

messages.author: 0b86ca0cb4b615b0
messages.subject: Re: recordTable: Generate a species record table from camera trap images
parts:
Hi Camille,
this problem may have to do with your "inDir" argument.
You currently use a relative path. inDir = "images_renamed" is equivalent to inDir = file.path(getwd(), "images_renamed"). The function thus assumes that "images_renamed" is a subdirectory of your current working directory. If it is not, the function cannot find the folder "images_renamed" and thus finds no JPG images in the place you specified. The error message comes from the function that reads out and tabulates the Exif metadata. But it did not find any image metadata ('data' must be of a vector type, was 'NULL'), and therefore can't tabulate anything. My apologies for the cryptic error message. Will be improved in the next package version.

The first thing you should try is to specify the absolute path (e.g. "C:/.../.../images_renamed", with your actual folder names instead of ...).Alternatively, use setwd() before running the recordTable function.

Please let me know if the error persists.

Best regards,
Jürgen
